title: RFC 10008: The new HTTP Query Method
summary: RFC 10008 defines a new HTTP QUERY method as an idempotent, safe operation for requesting parameter-based queries, addressing the limitation that GET requests cannot have request bodies for complex query operations while maintaining proper caching and proxy semantics.
problem_solved: Enables complex query operations with request bodies in a standardized, idempotent way without violating HTTP method semantics that restrict GET from having bodies.
why_valuable: Provides a standardized solution for RESTful APIs to perform complex queries with parameters in request bodies while preserving HTTP caching, proxy support, and safety properties.
